description: This Java source file defines an abstract validator class for MQTT connection configurations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes validation logic for source and target settings, MQTT-specific parameters like QoS and topic validation, and placeholder handling for address substitution.

classes.name: AbstractMqttValidator
classes.description: An abstract class that provides validation logic for MQTT connection configurations, including source/target validation, QoS levels, topic formats, and placeholder substitutions.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration for MQTT, checking for QoS presence and enforcement settings.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration for MQTT, including QoS and address format.

methods.name: getHiveQoS
methods.description: Converts an integer QoS value to the corresponding HiveMQ MqttQos enum.

methods.name: validateSourceEnforcement
methods.description: Validates enforcement rules in the source, specifically filters and placeholder substitution.

methods.name: validateEnforcementInput
methods.description: Validates the enforcement input configuration, ensuring valid placeholders.

methods.name: validateSourceQoS
methods.description: Checks that the provided QoS level for source is within acceptable range (0-2).

methods.name: validateTargetQoS
methods.description: Checks that the provided QoS level for target is within acceptable range (0-2).

methods.name: validateAddresses
methods.description: Validates MQTT addresses for sources and targets, ensuring proper topics without invalid wildcards.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Validates a single MQTT address, optionally allowing wildcards.

methods.name: validateMqttTopic
methods.description: Checks if a given topic string is a valid MQTT topic, with or without wildcards.

methods.name: invalidValueForConfig
methods.description: Builds an exception for invalid configuration values.

methods.name: applyEntityPlaceholderToAddresses
methods.description: Substitutes placeholders in a collection of addresses and returns a map of original to substituted addresses.

methods.name: applyEntityPlaceholder
methods.description: Attempts to substitute placeholders in an individual address, reporting unresolved placeholders.
